ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 75% high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) against 25% low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous areas across both lobes. Low-intensity clusters are concentrated at the distal tips (left and right edges) and the central longitudinal axis originating from the median notch. Sparse, punctate low-intensity mottling is distributed across the central regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 95 degrees and a medium bounding-box depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude variations. The boundary is largely continuous and smooth with minor, non-periodic pixel-level irregularities along the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a moderately concave mathematical curve sweeping from the median notch toward the distal tips.
